profile.name: Muhammad Hanif Hibatulloh
profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI & Machine Learning
about: I build practical software and intelligent systems through software engineering, AI, machine learning, and computer vision.
I approach projects by understanding the problem first, designing the right solution, testing it carefully, and improving it based on real results.
Beyond code, I bring experience in research collaboration, pesantren leadership, teamwork, and end-to-end creative production.

research.narrative: I am interested in designing reliable software systems with well-structured architecture, backend services, data-driven features, and practical AI integration.

focus.name: Software Engineering
focus.description: Designing reliable software systems with structured architecture, database design, testing, maintainable code, and practical AI integration.

focus.name: Backend Development
focus.description: Developing backend systems with authentication, role-based access control, database integration, server-side logic, and maintainable architecture.

focus.name: AI Integration
focus.description: Integrating AI and machine learning models into applications through data processing, inference, backend integration, evaluation, and feature development.

focus.name: Computer Vision
focus.description: Building image-classification solutions through preprocessing, CNN-based modeling, prediction, and performance evaluation on real-world visual data.

projects.name: EEG Classification
projects.summary: PKM-funded EEG research using DWT, Multi-Scale CNN, and Vision Transformer to classify motor imagery and concentration states.

projects.name: Banana CNN
projects.summary: CNN-based image classification for Green, Semi-ripe, Ripe, and Overripe bananas, achieving 95.12% test accuracy.

projects.name: Archive System
projects.summary: Web-based archive management system with authentication, role-based access, relational database integration, audit logs, and reporting.

footer: Building reliable software and intelligent systems, one project at a time.
